system.description:
You create a powerful updraft that sucks oxygen upwards robbing creatures of the ability to breathe within range. All casters of this jutsu create a 60-foot tall, 20-foot-wide cylinder that removes all air from inside of it replacing it with furiously rotating blade of Wind Release Chakra, centered on a point of your choice within range.

All creatures within the cylinder must make a Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save they are slashed with blades of wind taking 2d6 slashing damage and 2d6 wind damage and are robbed of their air in their lungs as they begin suffocating. A Suffocating creature can only survive a number of rounds equal to their constitution modifier before passing out falling unconscious from the lack of air or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature makes this saving throw the start of each turn they begin within this cylinder. An unconscious creature can regain consciousness when another creature spends an action waking them.

Creatures inside the cylinder cannot gain the benefits of an increase to movement speed and are treated as if they are in difficult terrain.

Combination: Increase the damage dealt by 1d6 for each damage type and the width of the cylinder by 5-feet, for every additional creature aiding in casting this jutsu, beyond the first two.
